title: too many combobox not long dropdown
rule: Too many (~15+) → combobox, not a long dropdown.

citation.source: NN/g — Does Your Form Really Need a Dropdown List?

pass_when: A ~15+ set is a combobox (type + list), not a long dropdown.
fail_when: A long dropdown of ~15+ with no type-to-find.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Apple combo-box pairing (`forms.inputs.combo_box`) as a duplicate; a house “15” as law.
